messages:
Nadia: quick follow-up from the postmortem 30bout cross-region restores. putting a short action list here so we can run a focused dry-run before EOW.
Omar: good call. i'll own snapshot replication checks and snapshot integrity validation. plan to add an automated md5 check and manifest compare.
Jules: i'll take DB switchover play and the short checklist for DNS + connection draining. need to confirm TTLs we can safely shorten during game-day.
Kai: i'll handle monitoring thresholds and alerting: set temporary higher-sensitivity on replication lag, and a dashboard for restore progress. also will add a synthetic read test after switch.
Nadia: proposed dates: dry-run Fri 10:00 PT, small rehearsal Thu 16:00 PT. which do folks prefer?
Omar: Fri works better for my team. i'll get the replication smoke tests in by Thu.
Jules: Thu rehearsal sounds fine if it's just a run-through (no traffic cut). will prep DNS rollback commands.
Kai: adding two quick monitoring items:
- temp alert: replication_lag > 60s -> pager on-call
- restore_progress_pct < 10% after 30m -> auto-cancel and rollback
Nadia: owners & deliverables:
- Omar: cross-region snapshot audit + md5 manifest script, put results in the action board. due Thu EOD.
- Jules: db_switchover.md checklist (conn drain, TTL change, secondary promotion, failback). due Fri AM.
- Kai: restore dashboard + synthetic read probe + alert rules. due Thu EOD.
- Nadia: book dry-run, coordinate with infra on reducing DNS TTLs and extra infra capacity.
Omar: small gotcha from last run: WAL shipping paused for 12m due to network blip. adding a pre-check: verify WAL shipping active and tailing.
Jules: also remember: when promoting read-replicas we need to clear replica reads in the api layer to avoid stale data. adding a single-line script to expunge sticky pins.
Kai: dashboard plan: include realtime bytes-restored, objects-restored, and estimated time to completion. will add annotation for operator actions.
Nadia: ops-bot will remind us 45m before the rehearsal/day. ops-bot: please post a checklist 30m prior with links to runbooks.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal Thu 16:00 PT; dry-run Fri 10:00 PT. Checklist will post 30 minutes before each.
Omar: snippet i'll include in pre-checks:
```
# verify latest replicated snapshot exists in target region
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups-eu --key prod/snapshots/$(date -I)-manifest.json || exit 1
# verify WAL tailing on primary
pg_replication_status | grep streaming || exit 1
```
Jules: rollback snippet (DNS + db):
```
# revert DNS to previous zone file
cli-dns deploy --zone prod --file dns-rollback.json
# demote promoted replica and rejoin as replica
dbctl demote --instance promoted-2026-03-xx
```
Kai: i'll run the synthetic probe script against the promoted host and record tail-latency in the console for 1h after cut.
Nadia: action: everyone reply with ":white_check_mark:" once you accept. also add estimated hours on the action board cards (so SRE can staff coverage).
Omar: :white_check_mark: adding 4h estimate for audit + script.
Jules: :white_check_mark: 3h for switchover checklist and DNS rollback.
Kai: :white_check_mark: 5h for dashboard + alerts + probe.
Nadia: thanks all. i'll send calendar invites and link the runbooks. moving items to the postmortem tracker and will close this thread when invites are live.
